issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() as returning int, while the template's comment hint and the provided solution implement and expect a double return type. This inconsistency can confuse students about which return type to implement and may cause mismatches with any tests or example code.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the specification and implementation. Preferred fix: update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double to match the template hint and solution (and update any textual references). Alternatively, change the template hint and solution to use int if the intent is to return an integer.
